status: Milestone B four-direction review; awaiting user approval; no integration
milestone_a: Approved by user after walk revision at b87e979d62abe5a547ee56ae9f1bcc11ac152aab; east non-walk PNGs unchanged; user subsequently requested walking/ear revision
format: RGBA PNG, binary alpha, nearest-neighbour; no per-pose scaling

direction_selection.rule: abs(x)>abs(y): east if x>0 else west; otherwise north if y<0 else south; diagonal ties use vertical direction

idle.note: Cosmetic 1.2-second breathing loop; existing idle has no gameplay duration.

walk.note: User-requested fluid walk revision: twelve poses over 800ms. Visual cadence only; movement remains 54px/s.

attack.note: Existing goblin timings, not player timings. Preview replay is a review control only.

hurt.note: User-requested 400ms cosmetic preview. Existing gameplay hurt timer remains 160ms; no stun or attack cancellation is added.

death.note: 720ms offline presentation study only. Gameplay death/collision removal/loot remains immediate; no new corpse/respawn timer is proposed.

exports.note: One common nearest-neighbour sampling grid per direction, all sized against the approved east idle height. Stable upper-head/ear silhouette registration: north/south centred on root, east/west 4px forward offset. Support foot remains grounded; no per-pose scaling.
